Write me a 3 paragraph story about a tiger who learns to cook biryani
8:08 AM

A young tiger named Sheru lived alone in the forest and ate the same raw meat every day. One evening, he smelled something incredible drifting from a village nearby—spices, rice, and something he had never tasted. Curious, he crept close and watched through a window as a grandmother stirred a huge pot of biryani, layering rice and meat with care.

The next night, Sheru returned and watched again, memorising every step. He gathered rice from a broken sack near the market, borrowed spices from a spice merchant's cart when no one was looking, and found a large clay pot by a stream. Back in his cave, he lit a fire, layered everything the way he had seen, and waited. The smell filled the forest, and for the first time, Sheru felt like a chef.

When he opened the pot, the biryani was perfect—fragrant, golden, and rich. He took one bite and roared with joy. Soon, other animals came asking for a taste, and Sheru realised he had found something better than hunting: sharing a meal he had made himself. From that day on, he cooked biryani every week, and his cave became the warmest spot in the forest.
